svg.text: Weak entities, identifying relationships, and the required ternary reservation are shown explicitly

text.tspan: Ternary rule: CUSTOMER reserves a SEAT for one LEG_INSTANCE.
The pair (LEG_INSTANCE, SEAT) must be unique.
Validation: the reserved SEAT must belong to the AIRPLANE
Introduced safe identifiers: Flight_no and Customer_id.

svg.text: Legend: underlined = key | dashed underline = partial key | dashed oval = derived | double outline = weak / multivalued | gold rectangle = associative | (min,max) = participation
